userStories.title: Attachment blob storage backend

userStories.notes: Phase 3 starts here. Delivered 2026-04-11: pkg/attachment/store.go defines BlobStore interface (Put, PutWithRID, Get, Stat, Delete, MarkLinked, CleanupUnlinked) plus ErrNotFound/ErrAlreadyExists/ErrInvalidRID sentinels and Attachment wire struct. pkg/attachment/local_store.go implements filesystem backend rooted at a dir, sidecar .meta.json + .blob files keyed by UUID suffix of ri.attachments.main.attachment.* RIDs (path traversal rejected), Linked=false by default.
